marked_enemy_covered_by_tower_count: {coverage_rule_text} How many towers cover the marked enemy?
{coverage_rule_text} Count the towers whose range rings include the marked enemy.
{coverage_rule_text} What is the number of towers covering the marked enemy?
{coverage_rule_text} Report how many tower range rings contain the marked enemy.
{coverage_rule_text} Count only the towers that cover the marked enemy.
covered_path_segment_count: {coverage_rule_text} How many path nodes are covered?
{coverage_rule_text} Count the path nodes covered by one or more towers.
{coverage_rule_text} What is the number of covered path nodes?
{coverage_rule_text} Report how many path nodes lie inside at least one tower range ring.
{coverage_rule_text} Count only the path nodes covered by at least one tower.

code_prompt_defaults.object_description_winding_path_marked_e: a tower-defense map with a winding path, circular tower range rings, and one marked enemy on the path
code_prompt_defaults.object_description_switchback_path_marke: a tower-defense map with a switchback path, circular tower range rings, and one marked enemy on the path
code_prompt_defaults.object_description_winding_path_covered_: a tower-defense map with a winding path, circular tower range rings, and discrete path nodes
code_prompt_defaults.object_description_switchback_path_cover: a tower-defense map with a switchback path, circular tower range rings, and discrete path nodes
code_prompt_defaults.coverage_rule_text_marked_enemy_covered_: A tower covers the marked enemy when the enemy is inside that tower's visible range ring.
code_prompt_defaults.coverage_rule_text_covered_path_segment_: A path node is covered when its center is inside at least one visible tower range ring.
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_marked_enemy_covered_by_: set "annotation" to [x, y] pixel points at the centers of every tower whose range ring covers the marked enemy; use an empty array when none do
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_marked_enemy_covered_by_towe: set "answer" to the number of towers whose range rings cover the marked enemy
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_covered_path_segment_cou: set "annotation" to [x, y] pixel points at the centers of every covered path node
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_covered_path_segment_count: set "answer" to the number of path nodes covered by at least one tower range ring
